oneLine: Lets a shopper return a shipped order group: decides where it goes (or that they keep it), gets the reverse label and closes the return when the centre grades it.

rows.title: Authorize a return for a shipped group
rows.story: A shopper asks to return lines of a shipped or delivered order group. The context decides the outcome itself: keep it (cheap lines), send it to the region's returns centre, or back to the node that shipped it.

then.does: keeps a return advice for the vendor that runs the destination node

rows.title: Issue the shopper's reverse label
rows.story: For a return that travels, the shopper asks for a label. The context asks the shipping context for it with a direct request, then links the tracking number. A return past its 30 days is cancelled instead.

then.does: adds the tracking number to the vendor's return advice

rows.title: Cancel a return before it travels
rows.story: The shopper withdraws a return while it is still only authorized. An expired return is cancelled the same way when it is next touched by a label request, a cancel or an outcome.

then.does: marks the vendor's return advice cancelled, unless an outcome is already recorded

rows.title: Close the return from the centre's graded outcome
rows.story: The returns centre grades the parcel through its vendor. The first outcome that fits an open return completes it with restockable and unsellable units; lines nobody authorized are only recorded.
rows.policy: Whenever a graded outcome fits an open return, complete it with the authorized lines only

then.does: adds the restockable units back to the matching listings

rows.title: Keep the placed order groups
rows.story: customer-ordering announces each placed order. Returns keeps every group with its lines and the order's postal prefix, so a return request only has to name the line numbers.
rows.policy: Whenever an order is placed, keep each group as promised, never undoing a status already seen

rows.title: Learn that a group shipped or arrived
rows.story: customer-ordering decides the shopper's notices. Shipped and delivered notices make a group returnable; lost and returned ones are recorded too.
rows.policy: Whenever a final notice is decided, set the group's status from it

rows.title: Keep the network's nodes
rows.story: node-topology registers each node with its type and region. Returns keeps them, so it knows which returns centre serves a region.
rows.policy: Whenever a node is registered, keep its type and region without changing its status

rows.title: Track which returns centres are open
rows.story: node-topology activates, suspends and retires nodes. Only an active returns centre is ever chosen as a destination; an older status change never overrides a newer one.
rows.policy: Whenever a node is activated, suspended or retired, move its status if the change is newer

rows.title: Map postal prefixes to regions
rows.story: node-topology assigns postal prefixes to regions. Returns keeps the newest assignment, so a group's postal prefix leads to its region's returns centre.
rows.policy: Whenever a prefix is assigned, keep it if its version is newer

rows.title: Remember who fulfilled each group
rows.story: order-sourcing locks a group to a node and releases it with each item's stock owner (also FulfillmentReleasedToNode). Returns keeps both, for the ship-back destination and the owner on each line.
rows.policy: Whenever a group is locked or released to a node, record the node and the item owners

rows.title: Count returns for the performance report
rows.story: Returns reads its own authorized and completed facts into a separate reporting store: returns per day and the reason mix, read by the returns performance report.
rows.policy: Whenever a return is authorized or completed, add it to the daily counts
updates: Returns per day and reason mix

hotspots.text: A lagging copy of orders or nodes refuses a return (not shipped, no destination); the shopper has to retry with the same key.
The reverse label is off until the shipping service address is configured; until then every label request answers label unavailable.
Doorstep pickup is dormant: nothing raises the pickup-failed state until the last-mile pickup wave arrives.
Lines the centre received but nobody authorized are only recorded; nothing here restocks or re-decides them.
The return rate is not reported: this context holds no delivered-order count to divide by, and no refund facts.

opportunities.text: A later event carrying the delivered-group fact could let the return rate be served from here.
